text:
Sara: Heads-up — planning a staggered canary for release 2.1.0 today at 18:00 PT. Proposed ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 45m (15m steps). need smoke owners + rollback ready. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jamal: I can own the smoke checks and be on-call for rollback. will confirm runbooks are up-to-date.
Priya: I’ll monitor the latency heatmap and error budget for the run. set alerts to page if p50 increases > 50ms or error rate > 0.5%.
Ana: infra-wise I’ll pre-check node capacity and pre-warm cache layers. have a snapshot of the model pool if we need to spin up fallback.
Leo: confirming no DB migrations in this release. I’ll stand by for any feature flag toggles.
Sara: Great. Regions: start in us-west and eu-west, hold APAC until 50% stable. cohorts: 5% = small internal slice, 20% = 10% of external traffic (low-risk domains), 50% = broad.
Jamal: Smoke checklist quick hits:
• sanity generation smoke (sample prompts)
• response format validation (json schema)
• kv-cache hit rates
• token billing sanity
I’ll post pass/fail after each step.
Priya: Dashboard links: latency: https://grafana/redwood/latency | errors: https://grafana/redwood/errors | infra: https://grafana/redwood/infra
Sara: Deploy command we’ll use (automated CI):
```
./deploy.sh --env=prod --release=2.1.0 --canary=true --steps=5,20,50 --regions=us-west,eu-west
```
Leo: Rollback plan: immediate scale-back to previous model variant + route all traffic to reserved pool. I have runbook snippet: `rollback --to=2.0.7 --force`
Ana: I’ll have capacity to cold-start fallback nodes in ~4m if needed and hang a manual hold on the ramp.
Priya: I’ll mute non-critical alerts for the first 5m to reduce noise, keep pages for sLO breaches only.
Jamal: quick q — who will do the final promote at 50%? Sara: I’ll promote after 30m of steady metrics post-50% and thumbs-up from smoke owners.
deploy-bot: [deploy queued] release=2.1.0 user=Sara ETA=18:00 PT
Jamal: can we add a guardrail to auto-stop ramp if p95 latency regresses by > 100ms?
Sara: yes — add auto-stop rule. Priya can you set p95 guard to 100ms?
Priya: done — auto-stop enabled: p95_delta > 100ms OR error_rate > 1%
Ana: snapshotting cluster state and kube manifests now. tag: canary-2187654321-pre
Leo: I’ll be by my laptop at 17:45 PT and will flip flags if needed.
Sara: Perfect. Final checklist before 18:00 — Jamal to post smoke kickoff, Priya dashboards, Ana infra snapshot, Leo flag UX, Sara promote/rollforward owner. ack with emoji when ready. :white_check_mark:
Jamal: ready :thumbsup:
Priya: ready :eyes:
Ana: ready :rocket:
Leo: ready :ok_hand:
Sara: thanks team — starting canary on schedule. will post status updates in this thread.
